createInvoice.q: How do I create a new invoice?
createInvoice.a: Go to the Invoices page and click 'Add Invoice' or just use the Shift+N shortcut from anywhere. Fill in the client details and items, then click save.

multipleStores.a: Yes! Use the store switcher in the sidebar (top section) to create and manage multiple business stores from a single account. Each store has its own inventory and customers.

voiceAI.a: Click on the microphone icon in Customer or Product pages (or use Alt+V). Speak the details naturally (e.g., 'Add a customer named Rahul from Delhi'), and our AI will automatically fill the form for you.

exportData.q: How do I export my data?
exportData.a: Most list pages have a 'Download' button or Ctrl+D shortcut. You can export data to PDF, Excel, or CSV formats for your accounting needs.

lowStock.a: In the 'Stock' management section, you can see products highlighted in red if they fall below your set minimum quantity. You can also generate a low-stock report.

gstReports.q: Where can I find GST reports?
gstReports.a: Navigate to 'Analytics' > 'GST Analytics'. Here you can view your tax liabilities and download GSTR reports.
